machine-generated texts analyzed for hierarchical discourse structures to distinguish them from human-authored texts

changes_made.explanation: Removed non-NLG tasks (authorship detection is the evaluation task, not the NLG task). Added specific text generation tasks mentioned in the paper. Normalized model names and clarified outputs.
Removed all metrics as they are used for classification/detection task, not for evaluating NLG output quality. F1 score evaluates detection performance, not text generation quality.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper.
No human evaluation of generated outputs is conducted in this paper.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on detecting machine-generated text using discourse structures, not on evaluating the quality of NLG outputs. The NLG tasks are present (text generation in various domains), but the evaluation metrics are for the detection task rather than NLG quality assessment. The extraction was mostly accurate but included some classification-focused metrics that don't belong in NLG evaluation.
